messages:
alisa: Heads-up — eu-west dedicated-pool-b is showing a spike in p95/p99 tail latency since the driver roll last night, guesses: NIC driver packet drops causing gRPC stalls.
devon: I see the same on the latency dashboard, packets/tx_errors jump at ~02:10 UTC. dashboard: https://dash/redwood/latency/eu-west
micah: can you paste dmesg / kernel log snippet?
alisa: yes — short snippet below from one affected host (rx/tx errors):
```
[02:11:03] igb 0000:03:00.0: tx timeout, resetting
[02:11:03] igb 0000:03:00.0: NIC Tx queue 3 stuck, tx_drop++
[02:11:04] igb 0000:03:00.0: device has memory leak warning
```
charu: that looks like the igb driver regression we saw in canary last week. driver package = igb-5.12.34-rc1, kernel 5.12.x.
ops-lex: incident created: INC-2026-112 by sre-bot :rotating_light:
sre-bot: INC-2026-112 — NIC regression causing multi-tenant tail latency in eu-west. severity P2, affected: dedicated-pool-b (10% of capacity).
devon: quick mitigation idea — flip scheduler flag to prefer warm-pool routing for latency-sensitive tenants for the next 2 hours, avoid allocating to affected hosts. That buys time to rollback driver or patch.
micah: agree, also cordon the worst hosts and drain with graceful window = 60s. run: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-03 && drain --timeout=60s`
alisa: started cordon on node 03/07/09. routing change applied: `scheduler.routing.enable_warm_shift=true` for eu-west.
charu: ops note — warm_pool size will need +3 prewarmed slots to absorb traffic, that increases hourly cost by ~0.9 GPU-hours. math: current prewarm 12 -> 15.
ops-lex: @finance FYI — if this lasts >4h we'll exceed this week's reserved commitment budget for eu-west burst capacity.
micah: plan B if rollback fails: apply driver knob `tx_coalesce=0` and lower irq_coalescing to reduce latency (will increase host CPU by ~2%).
devon: can we test `tx_coalesce=0` on node-07 (non-prod) first? micah pls run validation.
micah: running quick perf probe on node-07: `sudo ethtool -C igb0 rx-usecs 0 tx-usecs 0` then run small tail latency tests.
alisa: test on node-07 shows tx errors drop and p99 tail improves by ~250ms. snag: CPU jump visible but within SLO for background batch tenants.
charu: temporary mitigation approved. micah to apply across affected hosts, then ops will do driver rollback on stable window if root cause confirmed.
devon: timeline?
micah: apply knob across 7 hosts ~10 min, monitor 30m, then schedule rollback tonight 23:00 UTC if stable.
charu: tagging cost owner: increased prewarm + minor CPU uplift — estimate +$1.2k for the incident window if it lasts 8h.
ops-lex: logging action items: 1) apply ethtool knobs (micah) 2) cordon/drain infected nodes (alisa) 3) warm_shift routing on (devon) 4) schedule driver rollback pilot (charu) 5) incident doc updated (sre-bot).
sre-bot: updated INC-2026-112 with actions and links.
alisa: continuing to watch, p99 down ~200ms on affected tenants after knobs applied. will update in 20m. :thumbsup:
